measures.name: Revenue CY vs Revenue LY %
measures.expression:
VAR Result = DIVIDE ( [Revenue] - [Revenue LY], [Revenue LY] )
RETURN
    IF (
        Result > 0,
        "▲ " & FORMAT ( Result, "0.0%" ),
        IF (
            Result < 0,
            "▼ " & FORMAT ( Result, "0.0%" ),
            FORMAT ( Result, "0.0%" )
        )
    )
